title: ARCADE: COMBINED TEAM SCORE
why: His order for the Halloween party mode, build 8 of 20. In the arcade every kill scores for the player who made it, by kind: a crawler 50, a snitch 75, a sentry 100, a raider 150, a listener or howler 200, a bulwark 300, a warden 400, the Pillbox 500 and the Overseer 2,000, with an elite worth double. The two windows tell each other their scores, so both show one TEAM SCORE in the place of the raid clock, with YOU and the other player beside it, and an extraction tells the teammate PLAYER 1 EXTRACTED with the points. Scores belong to one arcade run, so a stale word from an old run never counts. Nothing is saved, and normal raids are untouched.
now: In the arcade every kill scores by kind, both windows share the score, and TEAM SCORE replaces the raid clock.
